fields.Status Detail:
On June 30, 2026 Aurora Generation told PJM it would retire all ten units on January 1, 2030 because of the Illinois Climate and Equitable Jobs Act. On July 2, 2026 PJM asked for the units to keep running until May 31, 2031, Aurora agreed, and Aurora withdrew its retirement notice.

https://www.pjm.com/-/media/DotCom/planning/gen-retire/deactivation-notices/il-assets-withdrawal-letters.pdf
https://www.pjm.com/-/media/DotCom/planning/gen-retire/deactivation-notices/il-assets-deactivation-letter.pdf

records.researcher_notes: Aurora's own letter of June 30, 2026 gave a retirement date of January 1, 2030. A second letter from Aurora dated July 2, 2026 says PJM asked for continued operation until May 31, 2031, that Aurora agreed, and that the retirement notice is withdrawn. Both letters are on PJM's generator deactivation page. Because the notice was withdrawn, no planned retirement year is reported. Nothing else was checked for this unit. No planned retirement year is reported because Aurora withdrew its retirement notice on July 2, 2026.

records.researcher_notes: The EIA-860M table for August 2026 lists plant 69979, MPH Elwood, generator GT1, 192 MW, natural gas combustion turbine, operating since 1999, on its retired sheet with a retirement date of June 2026. A Utility Dive article from April 2026 says the owner planned to retire the plant by June 1, 2026. That article gives a plan, not a confirmation. I did not find a PJM letter or news story that confirms the retirement itself, so this is a single confirming source. The unit shows as retired in federal data. No PJM or owner letter confirming the retirement date was found.

records.researcher_notes: A Dairyland press release from March 6, 2026 says Dairyland bought three combustion turbines of 450 MW at Elwood from J-POWER USA. Dairyland's withdrawal letter to PJM from May 6, 2026 says it acquired units 5, 6 and 7 on March 6, 2026. Both documents come from Dairyland, so they are not independent. I did not find a second publisher for the closing. The unit stays operating. The retirement notice was withdrawn, so the old planned retirement year of 2025 no longer holds.
